ideas.title: Farm Lightning for Fruit ⚡
ideas.hook: Storms roll over your farm every few minutes. Plant metal-tipped trees, and every lightning strike they catch grows glowing fruit worth more cash.
core_loop: Plant lightning trees on your plot
Wait for the storm and steer strikes with rods
Bat ripe fruit to the sell pad for cash
Buy taller rods and rarer seeds
ideas.twist: Bigger storms give rarer fruit but can also set unprotected trees on fire, so you balance rods against risk.
monetization: Luck pass for rare storm mutations
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm and Disaster / weather is the top gap in the data (score 6.63, thin). Grow / farm is the top rising mechanic at 1.89 (up 0.42 this week, 57 new games, 236,278 CCU) led by Throw a Seed (45,074). Disaster / weather is the top rising theme at 2.59 with Stop The Tsunami! (34,944).
ideas.differentiator: Garden games use passive timers; here the weather is the growth engine and players aim it.

ideas.title: +1 Brush Size 🖌️
ideas.hook: Every stroke makes your brush +1 bigger. Paint the arena floor in your team's colour before the timer ends, with fire or ice paint.
core_loop: Paint the floor to gain +1 brush size
Cover more ground than the other team
Unlock fire and ice paint types
Rebirth for a permanent size multiplier
ideas.twist: Fire paint melts ice paint and ice freezes fire, so elements flip territory, not just size.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 1.68 momentum (43 new games, 155,692 CCU) led by +1 Venom Evolution (21,396). Paint / create is rising at 1.58 (34 new games) with Hyper Draw! 🎨 and Paint and Hide! 🎨. Paint / create x Ice / fire / elements is an open gap (score 3.22).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a body stat; this grows a tool that changes the map, so growth is visible to everyone.

ideas.title: Draw a Glider ✏️
ideas.hook: Draw any wing shape, then get flung off a giant cliff. The better your drawing flies, the farther you go and the more cash you earn.
core_loop: Sketch a glider on the drawing board
Glide past distance markers for cash
Upgrade launch power and paper type
ideas.twist: Your drawing's real shape drives the physics, so funny scribbles crash and clean wings soar.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.58 momentum (34 new games, 96,715 CCU) and Hit / swing / launch is at 1.75 (58 new games, 545,078 CCU) led by Throw a Seed (45,074). Physics Sim is the top rising subgenre at 2.61 with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (155,402).
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games score the art; here the art is the vehicle, so creativity is tested by flight.

ideas.title: Roll for Reinforcements 🎲
ideas.hook: Two bases face off on a blocky battlefield. Roll dice each turn to send in soldiers, tanks or airstrikes, and push to the enemy flag.
core_loop: Win medals and new dice faces
ideas.twist: Doubles call in a surprise airstrike that hits both sides, so risky rolls can swing a losing match.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards x Military / war is an open gap (score 3.09). Military / war is rising at 1.54 (up 0.42 this week) led by Voxel Wars (29,364) and Ragdoll Wars! (10,955). Dice / cards is at 1.12 with [⚡] Steal a Superpower! (12,439). Voxel / blocky is the top rising art style at 2.46.
ideas.differentiator: War games are aim-based; this one is luck plus placement, so younger players can win.

ideas.title: Topple Watchtowers 🪖
ideas.hook: Realistic army watchtowers stand across a valley. Knock them down with cannons, rams and drills, and get paid by how hard they crash.
core_loop: Earn cash by debris and crash size
ideas.twist: Towers fall where you aim them, and landing one on another tower chains the payout.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is rising at 1.80 (up 0.38 this week, 47 new games, 308,159 CCU) with Flat the Mountain (21,416). Military / war is at 1.54 (up 0.42) with Voxel Wars (29,364). Break x Shooter pairs hold 163,392 young CCU, and Physics Sim leads subgenres at 2.61.
ideas.differentiator: Destruction sims smash random props; here aiming the fall is the skill.

ideas.title: Twister Brawl 🌪️
ideas.hook: A tornado roams the arena. Punch, bat and shove rivals into it, and the last one standing wins.
core_loop: Spawn into the arena with a weapon
ideas.twist: Anyone sucked in gets flung back from the sky as a falling hazard, so knocked-out players still matter.
ideas.why_now: Fight / battle + Hit / swing / launch is the top pair (12 new games, 219,558 young CCU). Fight / battle is up 0.35 this week to 1.19, and Disaster / weather is the top rising theme at 2.59 with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (155,402) and Stop The Tsunami! (34,944). Arena maps are rising at 1.50.
ideas.differentiator: Brawlers use static arenas; the moving storm makes positioning the main skill.

ideas.title: Crash-Land a Rocket 🚀
ideas.hook: Build a rocket, fly it to a planet and try to land it. Soft landings earn cash; crashes break parts you can salvage.
core_loop: Earn cash for clean landings or salvage from crashes
ideas.twist: Each planet has different gravity and weather, so a rocket that lands on the Moon may smash on a giant gas planet.
ideas.why_now: Space is the second rising theme at 2.55 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (16,209). Physics Sim is the top rising subgenre at 2.61 with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (155,402) and BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (46,700). Break / mine / dig + Race / drive pairs hold 167,736 young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Crash games stay on roads; this adds building and planet gravity, so each run is a new puzzle.

ideas.title: Grow Mushrooms in the Dark 🍄
ideas.hook: You farm rare glowing mushrooms in an old basement. They only grow in the dark, but something down there hates the light too.
core_loop: Keep lights off while they grow
Run when the basement thing shows up
ideas.twist: Flashlights save you but stop growth, so every light you use costs money.
monetization: Luck pass for rare glowing caps
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is the top rising mechanic at 1.89 (up 0.42 this week). Interior maps are the top rising map style at 1.52 (64 new games, 418,759 CCU) led by DONT SPLASH (33,472) and Cook Pizzas [Anomaly] (16,962). Money / rich is up 0.40 to 2.00 with Throw a Seed (45,074).
ideas.differentiator: Horror games rarely have a farming economy; here growing and hiding are the same choice.

ideas.title: Dig 1000 Blocks Down ⛏️
ideas.hook: Your crew starts at the surface of a blocky world and digs straight down. Every 100 blocks the ores get rarer and the caves get stranger.
core_loop: Return to camp to upgrade picks
ideas.twist: The shaft is shared with the server, so every crew's tunnels change the caves for everyone else.
ideas.why_now: Voxel / blocky is the top rising art style at 2.46 (21 new games, 242,670 CCU) led by 100 Miles Down the River (60,836). Break / mine / dig is up 0.38 to 1.80 with [WORLD 2] Sandworm Playground (22,419) and Flat the Mountain (21,416). Linear courses are rising at 1.15.
ideas.differentiator: 100 Miles goes across; this goes down, with a fixed depth goal and a shared, changing shaft.

ideas.title: Cannon Ship Rally 🏴‍☠️
ideas.hook: Pirate ships race around an island chain while firing cannons at each other. Sink rivals or outrun them to claim the treasure buoy.
core_loop: Pick a ship and crew upgrades
Fire cannons to slow or sink rivals
Win gold for place and sinks
ideas.twist: Sunk ships drop their cargo in the water, so trailing players can scoop loot and catch up.
ideas.why_now: Race / drive + Shooter pairs hold 198,528 young CCU across 6 new games. Shooter is up 0.22 this week to 1.36 with [🏹] Shoot Arrows For Animals! (31,801) and Voxel Wars (29,364). Ocean / pirates is at 1.12 (25 new games) with Risky Pirates! (4,692). Arena and linear course maps are both rising (1.50 and 1.15).
ideas.differentiator: Pirate games are open-sea brawls; this is a tight race with combat, so matches are short and replayable.
